narrative.overview: Rap Jumping reads like a seasoned instructor's own manual: authoritative, weathered, precise, and free of fluff. A warm, grounded palette (climbing chalk and basalt), a sturdy grotesk display voice over a highly legible body face, and generous reading space. It is a reference you trust with your safety, not a brochure that wants your booking. The single accent, Rope Red, behaves like a safety line: it appears exactly where the reader should act or follow, and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, grounded neutrals (climbing chalk + basalt), never cool corporate grey and never AI cream.
One accent only, Rope Red, used sparingly like a safety line.
Sturdy grotesk display (Space Grotesk) over a workhorse reading face (Inter); emphasis by weight.
Editorial-calm density: wide measure, generous rhythm, one idea per section.
Dual-mode from the ground up (warm light, warm near-black dark); reduced-motion honoured.
Legible to people and to machines, structured, scannable, quotable.

rules.name: The One Rope Rule
rules.body: Rope Red is the only accent and it is rationed. It marks where the reader acts or follows, never decoration, never two accents on a screen. Its scarcity makes it read as a safety line.

rules.name: The Chalk-Not-Cream Rule
rules.body: The warm neutrals are climbing chalk and basalt, forbidden from drifting into the generic AI cream/sand/parchment band. Warmth is carried by these exact values, not by tinting every surface warmer.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Two families: Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for everything read at length. Emphasis by weight and size, never a third family. Space Grotesk never sets body copy.

rules.name: The Kicker-Not-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label is a rationed brand device (hero pill, card kicker), not section grammar. Forbidden above every section heading.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat until the reader touches them. Elevation is feedback, not decoration.

dos: Do ration Rope Red to where the reader acts or follows. One accent, one hue.
Do keep warm neutrals at the exact chalk/basalt values; carry brand warmth in type and imagery.
Do set headings in Space Grotesk and everything read at length in Inter.
Do keep body measure at 65-75ch and reading rhythm generous; one idea per section.
Do maintain full light + dark parity and WCAG AA contrast on every change (YMYL safety content).
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and keep a visible focus-visible ring on all controls.
donts: Don't make it a loud tour-booking site: no discount banners, urgency, or BOOK NOW pressure.
Don't make it corporate/clinical: safe, neutral, forgettable is a failure.
Don't use the generic AI-landing kit: purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, three-equal-feature grids, hero-metric templates.
Don't use a border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, callouts, or blockquotes.
Don't put an uppercase eyebrow above every section, or number sections 01/02/03 by reflex.
Don't use gradient text, a second accent hue, or a third font family.
Don't let warm neutrals drift into cream/sand/parchment; that's the AI default, not this brand.
